kind: held-out-story sweep; window-level; no human-benefit claim
offset_grid_note: every point is a multiple of 12.5 ms; the shift is interpolated on the envelope grid, not rounded
sign_convention: positive offset = audio sample zero is later, so the reference envelope is read earlier; the same quantity as scripts/auditory/runner.py::replay_windows(audio_offset=)

method.envelope_shift: cached envelope sampled at (grid - offset); the EEG stream and the models are untouched
method.models: fitted once per held-out story fold at zero offset, then evaluated at every offset (a deployed model's tolerance)
method.metrics: nova2026.auditory.evaluation-compatible: accuracy, balanced accuracy, per-class recall and the majority rate

chain_audit.note: the chain path resamples the raw audio itself and needs no interpolation; the cached path interpolates the aligned envelope
chain_audit.offset_convention: cached = env(start + i - offset * rate); mirror = env(start + i + offset * rate)
